scope: Independent parser, preview/run contract, numerical guard and UI stale-response review; water-wave-dysthe-spatial-v1 only
security_observations: Own tokenizer and recursive-descent allowlisted AST; no eval, dynamic imports, filesystem access or symbolic algebra route observed.
Length, token, node, depth, exponent, scalar-parameter and sample-count bounds constrain evaluation work.
Each numerical intermediate is complex128, finite, magnitude-bounded and scalar or exactly axis-shaped.
Preview resamples on N and independent 2N grids and checks retained-band loss before permitting propagation.
Run independently validates/resamples and requires the exact normalized formula/settings fingerprint; untrusted fingerprints do not bypass checks.
Formula, parameters and errors are rendered with textContent, with request-token and exact-request-key checks preventing stale preview enablement.
Near-zero circular action moments produce unavailable packet-center metrics instead of numerical roundoff displacement.

tests.final_run_smokes: Two N=256, length=40, xi_end=0.005, dxi=0.0025 custom simulations, two propagation steps each; one through real loopback HTTP.
coverage: Gaussian complex initializer agreement including chirp
Sech formula agreement and scalar broadcast
Zero, underflowed, excessive-amplitude and aliased input rejection
Settings, finite-value/type and local work-budget rejection
Fingerprint changes for formula, symbols and every adjustable numerical setting
Complex128 raw/projected/propagated arrays and scalar Unicode provenance JSON survive export without pickle
Malformed and NaN/Infinity JSON creates no jobs or output
Stale/missing preview fingerprints create no jobs
Uniform periodic fields do not invent packet center, width or exterior-action metrics

limitations: Finite N/2N sampling and regime screens cannot prove resolution or physical applicability of an arbitrary analytic formula.
No custom-input grid, step or domain convergence campaign was performed; all custom results remain exploratory.
Independent UI code inspection complements, but does not replace, root agent browser end-to-end verification.
